title: SecurityAuditFindings
description: Findings document produced by a security-audit run. Conformance is enforced by scripts/validate_findings.py.

audit_id.description: Identifier of the audit run this document belongs to.

repo.description: Repository the audit was performed on (path or URL).

models.description: Optional record of which model performed which role (discovery, validation). Model-agnostic: names are informational only.

coverage.description: Audit coverage by repository area and attack class.

id.description: Stable identifier: SA-<attack-class>-<8 hex of sha1(attack_class|primary file|normalized title)>. Same vulnerability re-discovered independently recomputes to the same id, enabling dedup.

description.description: What is wrong and why it is exploitable. Distinguish source-code evidence from deployment assumptions.

attack_class.description: e.g. injection, auth-bypass, xss, csrf, ssrf, deserialization, race-conditions, memory-corruption, protocol-parsing, crypto, info-exposure, business-logic, dependency-config — or a repo-specific class.

lines.description: Relevant line numbers, verified by scripts/verify_references.py.

function.description: Symbol expected to appear in this file.

evidence.description: Quoted code from the original source.

functions.description: All functions involved in the vulnerable path.

attacker_capabilities.description: Which attacker profile (from the threat model) can do what to reach this.

trust_boundary.description: The boundary violated, e.g. 'network -> application', 'tenant -> tenant'.

exploit_path.description: Concrete steps from attacker action to impact.

status.description: confirmed requires poc_ref and reproducible evidence. unverified requires missing prerequisites in reproduction/notes.

reproduction.description: Exact steps or commands to reproduce; numbered strings.

poc_ref.description: Path under .security-audit/pocs/ holding commands and raw (redacted) output. Required when status is confirmed.

evidence.description: References to captured evidence (file paths, quoted output).

patch_ref.description: Path under .security-audit/patches/ to the proposed diff + regression test. Set only after human approval flow.

production_reachable.description: True only if repo evidence (not assumption) shows the path ships to production.
